We conduct a human evaluation using four annotators across 50 test samples.
guideline: Specifically, given an explanation, all annotators are asked to answer five questions: 1. Regardless of the prediction, can you see any relation between the original input and the concept used by the model? (Yes/No) 2. Given the prediction, does the latent concept help you understand why the model made that prediction? (Helps/Neutral/Hinders) 3. Given the prediction, does the explanation help you understand why the model made that prediction? (Helps/Neutral/Hinders) 4. Does the explanation accurately describe the latent concept? (Yes/No) 5. Is the explanation relevant to the task at hand? (Yes/No)
